business_change: Evolve the existing online-first pet triage system into an offline-first Android architecture. The client must complete multi-step triage flows without network, persist pending reports locally, and synchronize with multi-clinic cloud backends asynchronously. Conflicts between offline edits and cloud-side veterinary modifications must be resolved deterministically using Vector Clock or LWW strategies. No silent overwrite. No forced re-entry.

superseded_constraints.text: All client triage decisions must request the backend triage engine in real time before any diagnosis result is shown.
superseded_constraints.reason: Offline-first requires client-side decision tree execution without network.
superseded_constraints.replacement_intent: Client executes triage tree locally; backend is synced asynchronously.

superseded_constraints.text: When the network is unavailable, the client must lock the triage screen.
superseded_constraints.reason: Offline-first means triage must complete without network.
superseded_constraints.replacement_intent: Triage completes offline; results persisted as pending reports.

superseded_constraints.text: The client must not execute the multi-step triage tree offline.
superseded_constraints.reason: Core requirement of the migration is offline multi-step triage.
superseded_constraints.replacement_intent: Embedded decision tree engine runs locally with cached rules.

superseded_constraints.text: No background sync queue, retry ledger, or version vector.
superseded_constraints.replacement_intent: Sync queue, retry ledger, and vector clock/LWW metadata are new core components.

superseded_constraints.text: Single authoritative write path; concurrent clinic edits are outside design envelope.
superseded_constraints.reason: Multi-clinic sync means concurrent writes are expected.
superseded_constraints.replacement_intent: Multi-clinic replication with deterministic conflict resolution.

hard_constraints: Offline triage must complete without network
No silent overwrite of cloud-side veterinary edits
No forced user re-entry after offline completion
All conflicts must resolve deterministically or become explicit clinician-visible review states
Pending reports must survive app restart and device reboot
Sync must be idempotent and resumable
